description: What a roofnerd window is allowed to do. Deliberately almost nothing: open its own windows, talk to the document, and ask the operating system for a file the estimator picked by hand. There is no HTTP plugin here, and there will not be one — the program has no business reaching the network, and the shortest way to keep that true is to never grant it the ability. There is no file-system plugin either: drawings are read through read_page_source, which will not look outside the open job.
